name: DancingGhostStep
meaning: DancingGhost queued step (steps[0].step, PushStep arg 0; DancingGhost::UpdateState switch)

name: DG_STEP_ESCORT
meaning: case 2: walks (anim 6 WALK) with the partner to the Wolf's sides

name: DG_STEP_KILL_WOLF
meaning: case 7: STAND1/KILL, fireball after 4300 ms, kill msg 0 arg 8 after 20 s

name: DG_STEP_CARRY_WOLF
meaning: case 8: carries the Wolf with the partner (msg 0x416)

name: DG_STEP_POSE_STANDV2
meaning: case 11: anim 7 STANDV2 until the next step

name: DG_STEP_POSE_KILL
meaning: case 12: anim 8 KILL until the next step

name: DG_STEP_PAIR_DANCE
meaning: case 16: pairs with the nearest dancer (danceFlags.paired/leader)
